_comment: multiple-version line, MC 1.16.5 forge. Runs the standalone in-client UI test harness (uitest/mv-1.16.5-forge, an independent Gradle build in this repository on ForgeGradle 6) through the three-stage pipeline config->build->test: jt resolves and pins, reuses the JECh jar from the multiple-version checkout and compiles the harness build, then launches that build's runClient with the jars under test as -PjechJar/-PjeiJar. The two production (SRG-named) jars ride ForgeGradle's remapping fg.deobf configuration out of a content-addressed flatDir repository inside the build — a dev run has no runtime remapper, so the game directory's mods/ folder is the documented dead end for them (envs/README.md, `Forge rows and the gradle launch`). The client drives its own scenarios and writes report.json before it quits itself. The old skip's launch-path story is void: the checkout's own Forge dev run cannot host the mod under test — it rides a self-contradicting merged dev jar for 36.2.42, measured 2026-10-14 — while this harness build rides ForgeGradle's own userdev artifact for that loader and loads the mod under test as one jar. Harness-row shape, as the 1.21.1 rows carry it: no ready_when (stopping this client early would kill it mid-scenario and leave no report), no world (the level asserted against is the one the harness's runner creates and pins itself), and every artifact via=dev-classpath (the standalone build loads both jars itself, so a jt-staged copy would double-load). java is 17 — the JDK the harness build's Gradle 8.4 wrapper runs on, not the row's client: this line's client and its javac are the harness build's own toolchain 8, since MC 1.16.5 is a Java 8 game. History kept because the fixes still stand: the loader is 36.2.42 rather than the 36.2.39 the checkout originally pinned — the built jar's own mods.toml declares `forge [36.2.41,)`, so on 36.2.39 FML refused the mod and wrote a crash report (that red was the finding, measured 2026-10-14), and 1.16.5/gradle.properties now pins 36.2.42; the jei mod is pinned by file id to exercise the pin-is-used-directly path. The selection is the smoke tag alone: this line's JECh jar carries no JEI plugin class (measured 2026-10-15: no JechSearchStorage, and its JEI bridge is the legacy ASM coremod coremods/jei_transformer.js), and the JEI scenarios focus JEI's search bar with a measured mouse click that the 1.18.2 forge row established — this row has not been measured with that route yet, so it does not claim the scenarios that need it.
